title.narrative: Seven ears of corn to support agricultural families

description.narrative: The project aims to achieve food security and create employment opportunities for 1,250 beneficiary families in rural Idlib (750) and Aleppo (500) within the summer vegetable and wheat production chains. It also aims to train beneficiaries on best agricultural practices.

The project contributes to achieving food security and sustainability by supporting 750 of the most vulnerable farming families. This support encompasses summer vegetable production (250 families) and wheat production (500 families), and provides employment opportunities for 500 workers during the harvest season on a daily wage basis.

The project will produce approximately 2.5 tons of summer vegetables and 1,250 tons of wheat, contributing to food security, and will raise farmers' awareness of best agricultural practices for achieving sustainability.
